webServer.applyError: Could not apply hosted web settings
webServer.statusError: Could not get hosted web server status

updates.description: Install signed desktop updates without leaving Shikin.
updates.desktopOnly: In-app updates are available in the desktop app.
updates.idle: Check for updates when you want the latest release.

updates.noneToast: Shikin is already up to date

classificationTypes.sectionDescription: Define versioned names for the fixed financial treatments used by net-consumption reporting.
classificationTypes.revisionWarning: Revising a type creates a new version. Previous assignments keep their pinned name and treatment and are never reinterpreted.
classificationTypes.archiveWarning: Archiving prevents new selections; it does not delete historical assignments.
classificationTypes.draftPreserved: Your input was preserved. The catalog was refreshed; review the current version before trying again.
classificationTypes.createDescription: A custom name maps to one fixed treatment. It cannot create matches, receivables, or holdings.
classificationTypes.name: Custom name
classificationTypes.catalogDescription: Built-in policies are read-only. Custom types can be revised into a new version or archived.

currency.setupRequiredDescription: {{currency}} is only a setup suggestion. Save your choice to enable main-currency reports and conversions.
currency.mainDescription: The database-backed target used for reporting and manual conversions.
currency.mainChangeWarning: Changing the main currency never relabels accounts, transactions, plans, snapshots, or existing records. Add direct rate history for the new target.
currency.directionHelp: Direct rates only: no inverse, future, provider, or triangulation fallback.
currency.historicalWarning: This change can recalculate historical reports. Accepted transaction amounts and FX evidence will not be rerated.
currency.acknowledgeHistorical: I understand this change can recalculate historical reports.
currency.sameCurrencyError: Choose two different currencies. Same-currency conversion is already 1:1.
currency.historyDescription: Every row is retained. Corrected rows remain readable while their latest correction is used.
currency.emptyHistory: No manual rates yet. Add a direct rate to begin.
currency.manualRatesSummary: {{count}} immutable direct rates. Open to add a rate, review current authority, or correct history.
currency.currentAuthorityDescription: Active direct rates used according to their effective dates. Superseded rows remain in immutable history.

data.resetWarning: This will permanently delete all your data. This action cannot be undone.
data.description: Export a backup or import a database snapshot. Imports require confirmation and replace the current database.

diagnostics.title: Data identity
diagnostics.description: Database lineage follows a backup. Local instance identity belongs to this data root.

dataApis.description: Optional API keys for refreshing investment prices. Alpha Vantage is tried first, then Finnhub; use provider symbols such as WALMEX.MX when supported.
dataApis.alphaVantageHint: Free tier: 25 requests/day. Supports many US and some international/MX symbols.
dataApis.finnhubHint: Free tier: 60 requests/min. Used as a fallback for supported stock, ETF, fund, bond, or CETES-style symbols.
